import sys
from awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions
from pyspark.context import SparkContext
from awsglue.context import GlueContext
from awsglue.job import Job
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

# 1. Initialize AWS Glue
args = getResolvedOptions(sys.argv, ["JOB_NAME"])

sc = SparkContext()
glueContext = GlueContext(sc)
spark = glueContext.spark_session

job = Job(glueContext)
job.init(args["JOB_NAME"], args)

# 2. Read Silver order items
orders = (
    spark.table("globalpartners_silver_db.order_items")
    .select(
        "user_id",
        "order_id",
        "creation_time_utc",
        "item_price",
        "item_quantity"
    )
    .filter(
        F.col("user_id").isNotNull()
        & F.col("order_id").isNotNull()
        & F.col("creation_time_utc").isNotNull()
    )
)

# 3. Calculate item revenue
orders = orders.withColumn(
    "item_revenue",
    F.coalesce(F.col("item_price"), F.lit(0))
    * F.coalesce(F.col("item_quantity"), F.lit(0))
)

# 4. Determine reference date
reference_date = orders.select(
    F.date_add(
        F.max(F.to_date("creation_time_utc")), 1
    ).alias("reference_date")
).first()["reference_date"]

# 5. Calculate customer RFM metrics
rfm = (
    orders.groupBy("user_id")
    .agg(
        F.max("creation_time_utc").alias("last_order_date"),
        F.countDistinct("order_id").alias("frequency"),
        F.sum("item_revenue").alias("monetary")
    )
    .withColumn(
        "recency",
        F.datediff(
            F.lit(reference_date),
            F.to_date("last_order_date")
        )
    )
)

# 6. Calculate RFM scores (1-5)
recency_window = Window.orderBy(
    F.col("recency").desc()
)

frequency_window = Window.orderBy(
    F.col("frequency").asc()
)

monetary_window = Window.orderBy(
    F.col("monetary").asc()
)

rfm = (
    rfm
    .withColumn(
        "r_score",
        F.ntile(5).over(recency_window)
    )
    .withColumn(
        "f_score",
        F.ntile(5).over(frequency_window)
    )
    .withColumn(
        "m_score",
        F.ntile(5).over(monetary_window)
    )
)

# 7. Create RFM score and customer segments
rfm = rfm.withColumn(
    "rfm_score",
    F.concat(
        F.col("r_score").cast("string"),
        F.col("f_score").cast("string"),
        F.col("m_score").cast("string")
    )
)

rfm = rfm.withColumn(
    "customer_segment",
    F.when(
        (F.col("r_score") >= 4)
        & (F.col("f_score") >= 4)
        & (F.col("m_score") >= 4),
        "Champions"
    )
    .when(
        (F.col("r_score") >= 3)
        & (F.col("f_score") >= 3),
        "Loyal Customers"
    )
    .when(
        (F.col("r_score") >= 4)
        & (F.col("f_score") <= 2),
        "New Customers"
    )
    .when(
        (F.col("r_score") <= 2)
        & (F.col("f_score") >= 3),
        "At Risk"
    )
    .otherwise("Other Customers")
)

# 8. Write RFM results to Gold S3
output_path = (
    "s3://globalpartners-medallion-593271843946/"
    "gold/customer_rfm/"
)

(
    rfm.write
    .mode("overwrite")
    .format("parquet")
    .save(output_path)
)

print("RFM Customer Segmentation completed successfully.")

job.commit()
